# Bloom (`flowerBloom`)

A single flower swaying in a light breeze, set in tiny glyphs or glowing cells.

- Type: scene (draws its own image; put it first)
- Reacts to: nothing outside itself (pure motion)
- Cost: light (~1.6 ms/frame at 5K on a Pro GPU)
- Built-in styles: Blue Bloom, Baby's Breath, White Anemone

## Params

| key | label | kind | range / options | default |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `flower` | Flower | menu | 0 Blue Poppy · 1 Baby's Breath · 2 White Anemone | 0 (Blue Poppy) |
| `render` | Render | menu | 0 Glyphs · 1 Pixels · 2 Dots | 0 (Glyphs) |
| `cell` | Cell Size | slider | 7 … 24 | 11 |
| `breeze` | Breeze | slider | 0 … 1 | 0.5 |
| `gradient` | Sky Gradient | slider | 0 … 1 | 1 |
| `glow` | Glow | slider | 0 … 1 | 0.6 |
| `captions` | Captions | toggle | 0 / 1 | off |
| `size` | Size | slider | 0.7 … 1.25 | 1 |
